lines.context: David Hunterborough：实测台词，Wiki 核对身份与对话阶段
lines.text: You've mastered the fundamentals of hunting!
lines.zh: 你已经掌握狩猎的基本功了!

lines.context: David Hunterborough：实测台词，Wiki 核对身份与对话阶段
lines.text: At first, the attributes may seem weak, but over time they will grow stronger.
lines.zh: 刚开始，属性的效果也许不起眼，不过往后会越来越强。
lines.raw: §fAt first, the §cattributes §fmay seem weak, but over time they will grow stronger.

lines.text: The more you syphon an attribute, the more powerful it becomes.
lines.zh: 同一种属性的碎片，吸收得越多，属性就越强。

lines.text: Hunters continue to discover new Shards every year.
lines.zh: 猎人们每年都会发现新的碎片。

lines.text: Actually, I've got another gift for you...

lines.text: I guess I'm in a generous mood today.

lines.text: I crafted this Cloak some time ago. It seems to grow stronger with every hunt.
lines.zh: 这件披风是我前些日子做的。每次狩猎之后，它似乎都会变强一些。
